warning_registry.sample_only: Synthetic package fixture; not official source data.
warning_registry.coverage_review_incomplete: Domain coverage review is incomplete (NHI laboratory scope or TFDA IVD classification).
warning_registry.historical_query_unsupported: The serving NHI snapshot is current-only and cannot answer historical points.
warning_registry.deprecated_unsupported: Use list_matching_license_records; comparison and equivalence are not supported.
warning_registry.cancellation_date_without_status: TFDA source row has a cancellation date but a blank cancellation status.
warning_registry.cancellation_status_without_date: TFDA source row is marked cancelled or revoked without a cancellation date.
warning_registry.unknown_cancellation_status: TFDA cancellation status is not blank, 已註銷 or 已廢止.
warning_registry.cancellation_recorded_within_validity_wi: A cancellation is recorded while the validity date has not passed; this is not a valid-permit claim.
warning_registry.cancellation_recorded_and_validity_perio: A cancellation is recorded and the validity date has passed.
warning_registry.validity_period_elapsed: The evaluated date is after the source validity date.
warning_registry.cancellation_record_ambiguous: The cancellation record cannot be read as recorded or not recorded.
warning_registry.validity_date_unavailable: The source validity date is missing or invalid.
